title: Common support Frobenius cube components
statement: Fix D,C,E,n,hn and S:SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn as in [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. At the common coefficient stage let L be the Frobenius comparisons satisfying the corresponding normalization of [def-pod-semilinear-exchange-cube-data]. For the compact-support exchange and compact-support composition transformations, with independent model anchors and arbitrary geometric compactifications, the component cube equation c_F(K) α(P_in K)=P_out(α(K)) c_G(K) holds for every object K. Here the iterated comparisons and the actual transformations are precisely those of [def-pod-semilinear-exchange-cube-data]; use all separatedness, finite-type, finite-Tor, lattice and witnessed-origin restrictions specified there. This assertion is only the support underlying-category part, without fixed-pair equations or the representative-change intertwining conclusions.

proof.text:
Base change the chosen model compactifications along Frobenius and relabel
the source structural maps. Apply proper/open horizontal pasting to the resulting cube
and vertical pasting to the composition rectangle, as in fix-lem-exchanges. Its
refinement clause transports both equations to the arbitrary geometric compactifications
in the statement. Insert the displayed normalization formulas for each model anchor
and cancel adjacent comparison inverses. Localize integrally and then pass to common
finite-field representatives; scalar comparisons cancel at intermediate objects.
No compactification is required to descend and no coefficient domain is enlarged.
